decision.summary: Intake wrongly classified a front door fault as an appliance job. I reclassified it as urgent door/glass security, sent the tenant a safety note and questions, asked the landlord to choose a contractor, and put the ticket on hold with a review date.

answers.answer: At intake, now reclassified as an urgent front door fault. Outstanding: landlord decision, tenant answers on security and glass, then contractor assignment and a visit.

answers.answer: Landlord approval request (portal/agency landlord record) and tenant message (email on the existing thread), both sent.

answers.answer: Not yet. The landlord decides on the contractor. Escalate P2 if the landlord is silent beyond 3 days, or sooner if the tenant says the door won't secure.

args.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system wrongly treated it as a fridge problem; we have corrected it and are treating it as an urgent front door repair. Until it's fixed, please don't slam the door, as the glass could break. Keep clear of the door if you see any cracks. A few quick questions: 1) Does the front door close and lock securely at the moment, so the flat is safe overnight? 2) Is there any cracked glass? 3) Does the back door have the same problem? 4) Any access details we should know (entry codes, alarm) and any pets? We aim to get an urgent repair done within 72 hours of approval; we're asking the landlord now and will update you by tomorrow.
